decision.check: All visible faces, walls, rims and edges.
decision.defect_when: Brown, orange or red mottled oxidation with rough texture on intact metal.
decision.clear_when: No localized corrosion pattern is visible.
decision.review_when: Color or texture is too obscured to distinguish corrosion from finish or shadow.
decision.boundary: Missing material or a broken silhouette is edge_chip.
decision.localization: Tight box around each distinct corrosion patch.

decision.check: Sweep the complete visible surface and follow any candidate line end-to-end.
decision.defect_when: One thin, defined, continuous bright/bare-metal groove runs across a substantial distance of the surface.
decision.clear_when: Only normal grain, short polishing streaks, or no continuous groove is visible.
decision.review_when: Glare, blur or occlusion prevents deciding whether a candidate line is continuous and defined.
decision.boundary: A localized 3D depression is dent; a dark connected patch is dark_mark.
decision.localization: Tight box around each distinct line mark.

decision.check: Sweep faces, rims, edges, collars and flanges for contour changes.
decision.defect_when: Metal is pushed/deformed inward while material remains present, with a localized broken contour or depression.
decision.clear_when: The contour is intact and no localized 3D deformation is visible.
decision.review_when: There is not enough depth/contour evidence to distinguish deformation from a line or reflection.
ignore: Specular highlights on an intact contour.
decision.boundary: Missing material is edge_chip; a flat continuous groove is line_mark.
decision.localization: Tight box around each distinct dent/deformation.

decision.check: Trace the entire outer silhouette, rim and every flange/edge.
decision.defect_when: A notch, sheared break or chipped section shows material missing from an otherwise continuous silhouette.
decision.clear_when: The full visible silhouette is intact.
decision.review_when: The edge is cropped, blurred or obscured where a break may exist.
ignore: Reddish staining on an intact edge.
Pushed-in material with no missing section.
decision.boundary: Reddish oxidation on intact metal is corrosion; deformation without missing material is dent.
decision.localization: Tight box around each missing-material notch.

decision.check: Sweep the whole visible surface, every outer edge/rim and every hole/feature border.
decision.defect_when: A clearly visible, distinct dark surface blemish is present on the metal and is significant enough to be a reportable marking. It may be small or large, dark gray, brown-black, or near-black. When the blemish is connected, patch-like, irregular, or elongated, classify it as dark_mark.
decision.clear_when: No clearly visible, distinct, reportable dark surface marking is present.
decision.review_when: A candidate dark region cannot be reliably separated from normal finish, glare, shadow, lighting gradient, or image noise.
ignore: Diffuse lighting gradients without a bounded blemish.
Tiny incidental specks, isolated noise, or insignificant surface variation that would not reasonably be reported as a defect.
decision.enumeration: Report every distinct reportable dark_mark with its own tight box.
decision.localization: Tight box around the actual dark marking, not the surrounding metal.
decision.boundary: Dark_mark is based on the character of the marking, not a minimum length or width. A small but clearly visible and reportable connected/patch-like/elongated marking is still dark_mark. A compact isolated reportable blemish is dark_spot.

decision.check: Sweep the entire visible metal surface systematically, including the area around markings, holes, edges and transitions.
decision.defect_when: A clearly visible, distinct localized dark surface blemish is present and is significant enough to be a reportable defect. The blemish may be compact, narrow, irregular, or slightly elongated; it does not need to be circular or have a minimum width. It is a localized spot-like feature, not a continuous groove or a broad connected patch.
decision.clear_when: The inspected surface has no clearly visible, distinct, reportable localized dark blemish.
decision.review_when: A localized dark feature is visible but resolution, glare, shadow or finish variation prevents deciding whether it is a real reportable surface blemish.
ignore: Diffuse lighting gradient without a bounded footprint.
Tiny incidental specks, isolated image noise, or insignificant dark variation that would not reasonably be reported as a defect.
decision.boundary: Dark_spot is based on a compact isolated reportable blemish, not a minimum pixel size. A genuinely reportable spot may be small. If the feature is connected, patch-like, irregular, or elongated, classify it as dark_mark; if it is only incidental or insignificant, report neither.
decision.enumeration: Report every distinct reportable dark_spot separately; do not report incidental or insignificant specks merely because they are visible.
decision.localization: Tight box around the actual compact dark blemish, not the surrounding metal.

decision.check: Sweep the whole visible surface, edges/rims and feature borders.
decision.defect_when: A localized pale/dull low-luster patch contrasts with surrounding metal while underlying grain remains visible.
decision.clear_when: No localized dull/pale patch is present.
decision.review_when: Brightness and luster are too obscured to distinguish a dull patch from glare.
ignore: Specular highlight that is brighter and washes out grain.
decision.localization: Tight box around each localized dull/pale patch.
